record.field: INVENTARIO REPASO: generar picking de salida

if not records: active_ids = env.context.get('active_ids') if not active_ids and env.context.get('active_id'): active_ids = [env.context.get('active_id')] records = env['review.stock.picking'].browse(active_ids or []) if not records: raise UserError('Seleccione al menos un repaso.')
reviews = records first_review = reviews[0] eps = 0.0001 now = datetime.datetime.now() StockMove = env['stock.move'].sudo()
# 1. VALIDACIONES DE AGRUPACION (heredadas del wizard) # ------------------------------------------------------------------- for rev in reviews: if rev.state != 'done': raise UserError( 'El repaso %s debe estar Finalizado para generar el picking ' 'de salida.' % rev.name)
if len(reviews.mapped('company_id')) > 1: raise UserError( 'Los repasos seleccionados pertenecen a distintas empresas. ' 'No es posible agruparlos en un unico picking.') owners = reviews.mapped('owner_id') if len(owners) > 1: raise UserError( 'Los repasos seleccionados tienen propietarios distintos. ' 'Todos los repasos deben pertenecer al mismo propietario.') owner = owners[0] if owners else False if not owner: raise UserError( 'Los repasos seleccionados no tienen propietario definido.') destinos = reviews.mapped('partner_id') if len(destinos) > 1: raise UserError( 'Los repasos seleccionados tienen clientes/destinos distintos. ' 'Todos los repasos deben apuntar al mismo destino.') partner = destinos[0] if destinos else False
company = first_review.company_id
# Evita duplicar la expedicion cuando el modulo de re-proceso vincula # el picking generado al repaso (expedition_picking_ids). if 'expedition_picking_ids' in reviews._fields: already = reviews.filtered('expedition_picking_ids') if already: raise UserError( 'Los repasos %s ya generaron un picking de salida.' % ', '.join(already.mapped('name')))
# 2. CONFIGURACION: ubicacion de salida, tipo de picking y cliente # ------------------------------------------------------------------- cfg = env['review.stock.config']._get_config(company) exit_loc = cfg.exit_location_id if not exit_loc: exit_loc = env['stock.location'].sudo().search( [('complete_name', '=', 'TOR1/Expedicion')], limit=1) if not exit_loc: raise UserError( 'Defina la ubicacion de salida (TOR1/Expedicion) en la ' 'configuracion de repasos.') if not cfg.picking_type_id: raise UserError( 'No hay tipo de picking de salida configurado en Configuracion ' 'de Repasos para la empresa %s.' % company.name) picking_type = cfg.picking_type_id
customer_loc = env.ref( 'stock.stock_location_customers', raise_if_not_found=False) if not customer_loc: customer_loc = env['stock.location'].search( [('usage', '=', 'customer')], limit=1) if not customer_loc: raise UserError('No se encontro la ubicacion Partner/Customers.')
has_picked = 'picked' in StockMove._fields
# 3. TRASLADO DE MERCADERIA: SEPARACION -> UBICACION DE SALIDA # ------------------------------------------------------------------- # Un stock.move por producto y por repaso (origen=ubicacion de # separacion, destino=ubicacion de salida) con las mismas lineas # paquetizadas: package_id de origen y result_package_id de destino # apuntan al mismo paquete, de modo que el paquete entero se traslado. # Idempotente: si el repaso ya fue trasladado (movimiento done con # reference = nombre del repaso y destino = ubicacion de salida) se # salta y no vuelve a impactar stock. for review in reviews: dest = review.preparation_id.location_dest_id if not dest: raise UserError( 'La preparacion del repaso %s no tiene ubicacion de ' 'separacion definida.' % review.name)
already_transferred = StockMove.search([ ('reference', '=', review.name), ('location_dest_id', '=', exit_loc.id), ('state', '=', 'done'), ], limit=1) if already_transferred: continue
packaged = review.move_ids.move_line_ids.filtered( lambda l: l.package_id and l.qty > eps ) if not packaged: continue
transfer_moves = {} transfer_lines_by_product = {} for ml in packaged.sorted('id'): product = ml.product_id ml_vals = { 'product_id': product.id, 'quantity': ml.qty, 'qty_done': ml.qty, 'product_uom_id': product.uom_id.id, 'location_id': dest.id, 'location_dest_id': exit_loc.id, 'company_id': review.company_id.id, 'reference': review.name, 'package_id': ml.package_id.id, 'result_package_id': ml.package_id.id, } if ml.lot_id: ml_vals['lot_id'] = ml.lot_id.id if ml.owner_id: ml_vals['owner_id'] = ml.owner_id.id transfer_lines_by_product.setdefault(product.id, []).append(ml_vals)
for prod_id, ml_vals_list in transfer_lines_by_product.items(): product = env['product.product'].browse(prod_id) move_vals = { 'name': '%s - %s' % (review.name, product.display_name), 'reference': review.name, 'origin': review.name, 'product_id': product.id, 'product_uom_qty': sum(v['quantity'] for v in ml_vals_list), 'product_uom': product.uom_id.id, 'location_id': dest.id, 'location_dest_id': exit_loc.id, 'company_id': review.company_id.id, 'move_line_ids': [(0, 0, v) for v in ml_vals_list], } if has_picked: move_vals['picked'] = True transfer_moves[product.id] = StockMove.create(move_vals)
for move in transfer_moves.values(): move._action_confirm() move._action_assign() for move in transfer_moves.values(): move._action_done()
# 4. STOCK.PICKING DE SALIDA: UBICACION DE SALIDA -> CLIENTES # ------------------------------------------------------------------- # Agrupacion identica al wizard original: un picking draft con # partner_id = owner, location_id = ubicacion de salida, # location_dest_id = Partner/Customers, un stock.move por producto y # stock.move.line por detalle de lote/propietario/paquete. product_qty_map = {} move_line_vals_list = [] for rev in reviews: for ml in rev.move_ids.move_line_ids.filtered( lambda l: l.package_id and l.qty > eps ): product = ml.review_move_id.product_id product_qty_map[product.id] = ( product_qty_map.get(product.id, 0.0) + ml.qty) move_line_vals_list.append({ 'product_id': product.id, 'product_uom_id': product.uom_id.id, 'lot_id': ml.lot_id.id if ml.lot_id else False, 'owner_id': owner.id, 'quantity': ml.qty, 'qty_done': ml.qty, 'location_id': exit_loc.id, 'location_dest_id': customer_loc.id, 'package_id': ml.package_id.id, 'result_package_id': ml.package_id.id, 'company_id': company.id, }) if not move_line_vals_list: raise UserError( 'Los repasos seleccionados no tienen lineas paquetizadas ' 'para generar el picking.')
# origin segun los origin_doc de las preparaciones origen. docs = set() for rev in reviews: doc = rev.preparation_id.origin_doc if doc and doc.strip(): docs.add(doc.strip()) if not docs: origin = ', '.join(reviews.mapped('name')) elif len(docs) == 1: origin = docs.pop() else: origin = ', '.join(sorted(docs))
picking_vals = { 'partner_id': owner.id, 'picking_type_id': picking_type.id, 'location_id': exit_loc.id, 'location_dest_id': customer_loc.id, 'origin': origin, 'scheduled_date': now, } if 'owner_id' in env['stock.picking']._fields: picking_vals['owner_id'] = owner.id if partner and 'destino_id' in env['stock.picking']._fields: picking_vals['destino_id'] = partner.id picking = env['stock.picking'].sudo().create(picking_vals)
move_line_vals_by_product = {} for ml_vals in move_line_vals_list: move_line_vals_by_product.setdefault( ml_vals['product_id'], []).append(ml_vals)
move_vals_list = [] for product_id, total_qty in product_qty_map.items(): product = env['product.product'].browse(product_id) line_vals_list = move_line_vals_by_product[product_id] for v in line_vals_list: v['picking_id'] = picking.id move_vals = { 'name': product.display_name, 'reference': origin, 'origin': origin, 'product_id': product.id, 'product_uom_qty': total_qty, 'product_uom': product.uom_id.id, 'location_id': exit_loc.id, 'location_dest_id': customer_loc.id, 'picking_id': picking.id, 'restrict_partner_id': owner.id, 'company_id': company.id, 'move_line_ids': [(0, 0, v) for v in line_vals_list], } if has_picked: move_vals['picked'] = True move_vals_list.append(move_vals) env['stock.move'].sudo().create(move_vals_list)

POST-PROCESO: liberar reservas, vincular y avisar # ------------------------------------------------------------------- for rev in reviews: reservations = env['stock.quant.reservation'].sudo().search([ ('preparation_id', '=', rev.preparation_id.id), ('state', '=', 'reserved'), ]) if reservations: reservations.write({ 'state': 'released', 'release_reason': 'expedition', 'release_date': now, })
# Vincular el picking generado a los repasos que lo originaron para # poder rastrear la relacion picking -> repaso(s) en el re-proceso. if 'expedition_picking_ids' in reviews._fields: reviews.write({ 'expedition_picking_ids': [(4, picking.id)], })
